Two injured in Srinagar after police clarify road rage incident

Two teenagers sustained injuries in Srinagar following a scuffle attributed to road rage. Initial reports suggested a knife attack, but police clarified that the incident involved a road rage scuffle and denied any knife attack. The injured individuals were hospitalized.
